summary: Domestic game-production payroll FTE is verified for 2017–2022 in the 2024 edition. Earlier 2015–2017 and 2016–2019 vintages are retained separately because the population was redefined. The June 2026 Tableau workbook was downloaded and decoded: it covers film, TV and advertising only, with no games segment.

search_log.outcome: Statistical source found through producer report; payroll FTE definitions inspected.
Newer Tableau release fully downloaded and decoded through public .twb endpoint; no SPIL segment exists. Earlier 2018/2021 reports supply 2015/2016 vintages.
200 response with 44,152 byte packaged workbook; decoded all threeHyperfiles and verified onlyFILM/TV/REKLAME segments. Older guessed 2024/2023 workbook endpoints 404.

sources.notes: Initial .twbx request 404; correct .twb endpoint returned packaged workbook. Extracts updated 24 June 2026. No games employment can be read from this workbook because that segment is absent, not because access failed.

series.label: Domestic game-production payroll FTE
series.industry_scope: Core game content producers; excludes serious games/XR classified under Interactive
series.geography_note: See comparison note; local operations rather than nationality unless explicitly stated

series.contractor_treatment: Payroll-covered temporary/freelance employment counts as hours; invoice contractors excluded

series.label: Game-production payroll FTE, 2018 coverage

series.geography_note: See comparison note; local operations rather than nationality unless explicitly stated
series.worker_status: Full-time equivalent employment in selected private production companies; detailed freelancer boundary not established in this older edition
series.contractor_treatment: No quantified separate contractor share; cannot assume current selection criteria applied historically
series.method: Statistics Denmark special extraction on selected company CVR numbers
series.comparison_note: Separate historical vintage. Do not splice with 2021 or 2024 editions: population changed. 2017 old value 1,009 differs from 2024 vintage 737.

series.label: Game-production payroll FTE, 2021 coverage
series.industry_scope: Entertainment game producers; serious games and XR assigned to Interactive
series.geography_note: See comparison note; local operations rather than nationality unless explicitly stated

series.contractor_treatment: Supplier-only and many sole-proprietor freelancer businesses excluded; no contractor share reported
series.method: Statistics Denmark business register, HBS Economics and manual industry selection; retrospective 2019 cohort
series.comparison_note: 2016–2019 within-vintage history; not a year-by-year complete historical population. 2021 report expressly warns against edition comparison.
